'''Bandry Crawe''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident and son of [[Samel Crawe]]. 
== Activities ==
Bandry also saw the [[Myrddraal|dark rider]] prior to the attack on Edmond's Field on [[Winternight]].{{ref/book|1|4}}

He is part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.

He accompanies Perrin into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]].
